notes.title: 📢 Dreadzone – Upcoming Major Update
notes.content:
[p][b][i]Hello survivors![/i][/b][/p][p]First, we want to thank you as always for your amazing support and feedback. A huge thank you to the players in our community on [b]Discord[/b] and [b]Steam[/b].[/p][p]This weekend, there will [b]not[/b] be a new update release. Instead, we are taking the extra time to push forward toward the [b]Next Major Update[/b]. Skipping this small update will pay off, because [b]next week you’ll be getting lots of new content[/b]![/p][h3]🔎 Sneak Peeks – Coming Next Week:[/h3][list][*][p][b]The World Map is Expanding![/b]
A brand-new segment of the world is being released, making the map nearly [b]2x the current size[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]New POIs and places to explore[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New Mission Givers[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New Missions[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New Items[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New Buildables[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]More fixes and improvements[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]More balancing and tweaking[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]QOL additions[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505625/ebb1797b86120df04a7999a5cad4bde5ed3bdd8d.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505625/4907163f2d79165b37b6c28911d92a32b608eece.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505625/ddb3d29d4bfeb1dee708c97240f71c53f19d2079.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505625/fff0e00cd9b6f824bd9dbe2525364534c7ab20c3.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505625/1edd1a7875c8c28e74f3cc62145d6efee153ec43.png"][/img][/p][p]We can’t wait for you to experience everything we’ve been working on.[/p][p]Thank you again to our amazing players and community. We wish everyone a [b]great weekend ahead—chill, fun, and full of good vibes[/b]. And as always…[/p][p][b]Happy gaming,
– The Dreadzone Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: DREADZONE v1.4.5 – Durability Update
notes.content:
[p][i][b]Hello survivors,[/b][/i][/p][p]First off, thank you once again for the amazing support and feedback. Huge thanks to the community — to the kind-hearted members on [b]Steam[/b], [b]Discord[/b], and everyone who's playing. We appreciate your support from the bottom of our hearts.[/p][p]This is a [b]major technical update[/b] that also impacts the [b]core gameplay loop[/b]. With the introduction of [b]item durability[/b], you'll now need to manage your tools, weapons, and armor more carefully — make sure to repair your gear or swap them out before they break.[/p][h3]⚙️ [b]Features & Content[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added a full [b]Item Durability System[/b][/p][list][*][p]Weapons, tools, armor, and more now degrade over time with use[/p][/*][*][p]Items can be repaired or replaced when worn[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added a [b]buildable Repair Bench[/b] under the Utility category[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505625/fab66d37337b729a8f913b7f4f32ed5df5e6e6e2.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Introduced a [b]new weapon variant: RK-47[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505625/34f344d19833cd099a8c19300f98ee34046d9435.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Remade and improved the [b]Armor System[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]Wandering Trader[/b] who moves around the zone with rare items to trade[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]buildable Gas Canister[/b] (explodes when shot)[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]large version[/b] of the Gas Canister[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]buildable Plastic Barricade[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]buildable Storage Fridge[/b][/p][/*][*][p]All new buildables are added to the [b]Blueprints menu[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505625/b3e4c91c6ca298b8ebab04b02ad8b08f7523f3b0.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🔄 [b]Changes and Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Armor stats rebalanced and improved to match the new durability system[/p][/*][*][p]Patrol Helicopter balancing:[/p][list][*][p]Increased health, armor, and fire rate[/p][/*][*][p]Added missile attack ability[/p][/*][*][p]Despawn after a certain time[/p][/*][*][p]Loot drops rebalanced[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Reworked and improved the [b]Building Repair mechanic and UI[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced [b]building durability[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Balancing and tweaks to:[/p][list][*][p][b]Loot tables[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Item prices[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Trading economy[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Food and drink stats[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Tweaks to AI accuracy and behavior[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved AI navigation[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved NVG[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Toggle Run (Hold)[/b] option in Gameplay Settings[/p][/*][*][p][b]Nearby Camps and Mission Givers[/b] now display [b]map markers[/b] when close[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505625/1e34c1baa3322361f1048f5497988f4be9aa13b0.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Night Time duration increased[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Minor tweakes to tutorial missions[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Various [b]UI improvements[/b] and [b]translation fixes[/b][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🐞 [b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug causing animals to walk slowly after exiting water[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with water camper[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed minor UI bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed certain translation errors[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bugs with Night Vision Goggles (NVG)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed minor animation issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed minor issues with buildables and repair functionality[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiple small bugs across systems[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🔜 [b]What’s Next[/b][/h3][p]This update marks another big step forward as we prepare for an upcoming [b]major content expansion[/b]. Currently in development:[/p][list][*][p]A [b]new large area[/b] of the map[/p][/*][*][p]New [b]POIs[/b], [b]missions[/b], and [b]items[/b][/p][/*][*][p]And a [b]secret surprise[/b] we’ll reveal soon...[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ll be sharing progress and sneak peeks in the coming weeks.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🧷 [b]Important Note for Pre-Update Save Files[/b][/h3][p]Due to the introduction of the [b]Durability System[/b], items from older save files (before this update) may appear [b]broken[/b].[/p][p]To help with this transition:[/p][list][*][p][b]For the next 48 hours[/b], all [i]broken[/i] items in older saves will [b]auto-convert to fully repaired[/b] items.[/p][/*][*][p]After 48 hours, [b]any un-loaded save[/b] will keep its broken items, which will need to be [b]repaired using a Repair Bench[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]If you've [b]already loaded your save after the update[/b], you're good — your items are safe.[/p][/*][/list][p]If you miss the 48-hour window, you can use our special [b]FixDurability[/b] Beta Branch:[/p][olist][*][p]Right-click [b]Dreadzone[/b] in your Steam Library[/p][/*][*][p]Go to [b]Properties > Betas[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Select the [b]FixDurability[/b] branch[/p][/*][*][p]Let the update download, [b]load your save[/b], then [b]quit the game[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Return to [b]Properties > Betas[/b] and set it back to [b]"None"[/b] to return to the latest version[/p][/*][/olist][p]We’ve also added a new [b]Last_Stable[/b] Beta Branch — this will revert the game to the last most stable version before this update.[/p][quote][p]⚠️ [b]Note:[/b] You won’t be able to play multiplayer with others using different branches, and the [b]Last_Stable[/b] version will not include any of the new features or updates from v1.4.5.[/p][/quote][p][/p][p]We wish you all a [b]happy, chill, and fun weekend[/b] — and as always,
[b]Happy gaming![/b][/p][p]— [b]The Dreadzone Team[/b][/p]

Huge thanks to the community member who shared their save files and helped us identify the issue. Let us know if the fix works for you![/p]

notes.title: 🚨 MAJOR UPDATE DREADZONE v1.4.2
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello Survivors,[/b][/p][p]We want to extend our deepest thanks to all of you for your incredible support, feedback, bug reports, and suggestions. To the kind-hearted people in this community — thank you. You’re helping shape the [b]future of Dreadzone[/b], and your input plays a direct role in the game's development.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🧪 DLSS, FSR & TSR - Fully Implemented![/h3][p]Thanks to the players who tested our [b]Beta Branch[/b] and provided feedback on the experimental performance features — we’re excited to announce that [b]DLSS 4[/b], [b]FSR 3.1[/b], and an [b]improved TSR[/b] are now fully implemented!
This also includes [b]Frame Generation[/b], giving players enhanced performance, image clarity, and full control over sharpening and blur reduction.[/p][p]This is a major leap forward for [b]performance[/b] and [b]visual fidelity[/b] in Dreadzone.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]✨ New Quality of Life Features:[/h3][list][*][p]✅ Added [b]"Always Show Hotbar"[/b] option in Gameplay Settings[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Added [b]Toggle Aim[/b] option[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Added [b]Toggle Crouch[/b] option[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Improvements to [b]Keybinds UI in Inventory Menu[/b][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Gathered/Harvested items[/b] now appear in the [b]pickup notification feed[/b][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🐞 Bug Fixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a [b]major performance bug[/b] affecting multiple systems[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]client replication issues[/b] in multiplayer[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]item duplication exploit[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]bed respawn bug[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]"mortally wounded"[/b] recovery bug[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]interaction inconsistencies[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]equipped weapon desync[/b] issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug causing [b]exit button[/b] to not appear properly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]shadow and lighting artifacts[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiple [b]physics-related bugs[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed general [b]performance issues[/b] and minor [b]multiplayer problems[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the [b]weapon to aim upward unintentionally[/b][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]⚙️ Features & Improvements:[/h3][list][*][p]🔧 Added [b]Equipped Armor Durability Indicator[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🔧 New Keybind: [b]Check Ammo in Weapon Magazine[/b] (Default Key: [b]V[/b])[/p][/*][*][p]🔧 Further balancing and increased [b]battery drop rate[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🔧 [b]General UI improvements[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🔧 [b]Adjustments and tweaks to SFX[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🔧 Balancing and tweaks to [b]player, NPCs, and equipment stats[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🔧 [b]Bullet Penetration[/b] Player bullets can now [b]penetrate more surfaces[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🔧 Tweaked [b]AI accuracy and responsiveness[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🔧 Improved [b]recovery stats[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🔧 Improved [b]performance for the character system[/b][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🌍 A Look Ahead: What’s Coming Next[/h3][p]We also want to share what’s ahead for the [b]next major update[/b]:[/p][p]🚧 [b]We’re expanding the world to be 2X larger[/b] than it is now!
This next content expansion will include:[/p][list][*][p]🧭 New [b]missions[/b] and [b]mission vendors[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🧪 New [b]items[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🏚️ New [b]events[/b] and [b]POIs[/b][/p][/*][*][p]👾 New [b]enemy types[/b][/p][/*][*][p]❓[b]Potential secret content[/b] (we won’t spoil it — if it makes it in, it’ll be a surprise)[/p][/*][/list][p]This will mark the beginning of ongoing [b]content updates[/b], and it’ll take a little longer to develop. We’ll be sharing progress with you as it comes together.[/p][p]We remain [b]on standby[/b] for hotfixes and small patches for any urgent issues that arise in the meantime.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Wishing everyone a calm and relaxing weekend ahead![/p][p]Thank you again for being part of the Dreadzone journey.
[b]We’re just getting started.[/b][/p][p]— [b]The Dreadzone Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: DAY 1/2 UPDATE — DREADZONE v1.3.9.1
notes.content:
[p][b]Hey everyone![/b][/p][p][b]Here’s another quick Day 1/2 patch for Dreadzone. We want to thank you once again — your support and feedback truly means the world to us. Every bit helps us improve the game![/b][/p][h3]🛠️ Patch Notes:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a reflection bug that was causing performance drops[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a background system memory leak[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing collision on several objects[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed floating objects in certain POIs[/p][/*][*][p]Minor improvements to UI elements[/p][/*][*][p]Improved navigation mesh for better AI movement[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked AI behavior: certain enemies will now stop engaging if players are too far from their effective range[/p][/*][*][p]Added a system to detect if the player goes out of bounds — you’ll now be returned to your last relative location + hidden keybind for self-damage (for respawn): [b]\[X + Num9][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Lit campfires[/b] now deal damage to anything stepping on them[/p][/*][/list][p]More improvements and updates are on the way — stay tuned, and keep the feedback coming![/p][p]We wish everyone a [b]great, happy, and chill weekend[/b] — and as always, [b]happy gaming[/b]![/p][p]Thanks for playing,
[b]The Dreadzone Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: DAY 1 UPDATE — DREADZONE v1.3.9
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello everyone![/b][/p][p][b]Thank you all so much for your support and feedback — it truly means the world to us. We're thrilled to see many of you enjoying the game! This small update includes a batch of important fixes, tweaks, and balancing improvements:[/b][/p][h3]🛠️ Patch Notes:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed minor UI bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a background system causing performance issues after 3+ hours of gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed sound attenuation bug[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered [b]Normal Mode[/b] difficulty by 5%[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug causing players to fall through the ground[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed floating foliage in various areas[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a controller issue where the main menu wouldn't open — you can now open it using the [b]Special Right Button[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Added a hidden keybind for self-damage (for respawn): [b]\[X + Num9][/b][/p][/*][*][p]Improved and balanced:[/p][list][*][p]Armor values[/p][/*][*][p]Damage and accuracy[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy spawn rates[/p][/*][*][p]Other combat-related stats[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Thanks again for playing — more updates are coming soon![/p][p]Stay sharp,
[b]The Dreadzone Team[/b][/p]
